persuasionAngle.rationale: Shows that using Stripe isn't 'lazy' — it's actually more technically sophisticated than building in-house. The code snippet proves they can get production-ready payments in minutes, not months, while the webhook example shows they maintain full control and customization. Addresses the core objection 'Am I being lazy?' by reframing it as 'Am I being smart?'
